name: Giving the Best: Shadows of the Past
source:
Welcome back to the 'Giving the Best' experience! Prepare yourself for a magical evening with the Vampiric Count Berkant, and unravel the mystery surrounding the Shadows of the Past as well as the fears of the future! 

You are a highly qualified diplomat and in your bid to bring peace to the region, you discover that someone wants you dead, but you don't know why! 

The vagabondish 'Count Berkant' is by your side on a wonderful tropical island...but a question lingers in your mind, who is the ancient dragon on the walls of the island's temple, and why does it look like the tech guy, Rakki?

👾[s]Help him fill the gap, bring him one step closer to Paradise.[/s]👾

[Edited from [url=https://hyakuten-games.itch.io/giving-the-best-shadows-of-the-past]itch.io[/url]]
